bio: Hey y'all!! My name is Alyssa Rubio and I am from the great and proud state of Texas living in Weld! I plan to concentrate in either Molecular and Cellular Biology or History of Science with a secondary in Econ (yay premed)!! On campus I am also involved in Harvard Undergraduate Consulting Group, Alpha Phi, and Harvard Undergraduate Pediatric Cancer Buddies. In my free time I love to hang out with my friends whether that means walking around the square, chatting in the yard, or taking trips into Boston! I'm so excited to be apart of FYSC and can't wait for the rest of the semester! Please feel free to reach out with any suggestions, questions, or just to chat!
